test_play_event_inline.title: Play Video on an event opens the inline player

steps.action: On Events, pick the site and search, hover the first event and click Play Video.
steps.expected: The inline player opens and shows one pause control, so the clip is playing.

test_player_controls_visible.title: The inline event player shows its pause, backward, forward and volume controls

steps.action: On Events, pick the site and search, hover the first event and click Play Video.
steps.expected: The player shows one pause control, the backward control, one forward control and one volume control.

test_event_action_toolbar.title: The event player shows its Share, Export and lightbox actions

steps.action: On Events, pick the site and search, hover the first event and click Play Video.
steps.expected: The inline player opens.

steps.action: Read the player's action toolbar.
steps.expected: One Share button, one Export button and one lightbox button show.

test_close_event_player.title: Verify closing the player returns to event search results.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Events Panel
steps.expected: Events Panel page loads without errors

steps.action: Note the current state of closing event playback restores previous grid before making changes
steps.expected: Initial state is observed and recorded

steps.action: Perform the action that changes closing event playback restores previous grid
steps.expected: Action is completed and change is reflected in the UI

steps.action: Verify the change is displayed correctly before leaving the page
steps.expected: Updated state is visible on the current page

steps.action: Refresh the page (F5 or browser reload)
steps.expected: Page reloads completely

steps.action: Verify closing event playback restores previous grid retained the changes after refresh
steps.expected: The change persisted through the page refresh

steps.action: Navigate away to a different page
steps.expected: Different page loads successfully

steps.action: Navigate back to Events Panel page
steps.expected: Events Panel page loads

steps.action: Set up precondition: without losing cameras
steps.expected: Precondition is met (without losing cameras)

steps.action: Verify closing event playback restores previous grid still reflects the saved changes
steps.expected: Changes persist after navigating away and back
